integrity: Analytic proof and an executable independent-deck-enumeration numerical cross-check are provided; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Only flat Klein bottles; the pointwise orbit-displacement formula is known (Sabourau 2026) and is not claimed novel. The new asserted conclusion is the unique shape maximizing the area-normalized mean. Historical priority of this sharp optimization is not independently established.
title: The unique mean-injectivity-radius optimizer among flat Klein bottles
